rows.jp: この道で、よく遊紗ちゃんと出会った。

rows.jp: こそばゆい、存在だった。
rows.en: Having her around left me pleasantly self-conscious.

rows.en: “You haven’t eaten?”

rows.en: “I am saving myself for first period.”

rows.en: “…Eating curry bread is a class now?”

rows.en: “I hate curry.”

rows.jp: 謎だ……こいつだけは本当に……。
rows.en: A mystery… This guy truly was a mystery…

ghs.en: An enigma... at the very least, this guy, really...

rows.jp: なんでわざわざ来たんだろう。
rows.en: Why had he bothered coming at all?

ghs.en: What'd he even intentionally come here for?

rows.jp: 適応係数で弾かれたわけでもないだろうし。
rows.en: It was not as though the adaptation coefficient would have screened him out.

ghs.en: It's very unlikely that with his Conformity Coefficient he'd just snap.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says the person was rejected or screened out by the coefficient; the highlighted word does not express that result.

rows.jp: やっぱ親の財力で圧力をかけて……。
rows.en: So his parents really had used their money to apply pressure…

ghs.en: I knew it, it's just the pressure of his parents' assets...
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says parental wealth was used to exert pressure; the English makes the assets themselves the pressure and obscures the actor and action.

highlights.text: I knew it, it's just the pressure of his parents' assets...

rows.en: “I was just realizing how utterly meaningless your existence is.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was just enlightened as to the meaninglessness of your presence right now."

rows.en: “What…? My old man said I am the world itself, you know.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "What... don't you know my old man said I am the world itself?
ghs.assessment: The English dialogue opens a quotation but does not close it.

highlights.text: Sakuraba: "What... don't you know my old man said I am the world itself?

rows.jp: 「おまえのオヤジは生暖かすぎるんだよ！」
rows.en: “Your old man is far too indulgent with you!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Your old man is way too tepid with you!"

rows.jp: 「不思議な言われ方だ……」
rows.en: “What a strange way to put it…”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "The way you put that is inexplicable..."

rows.jp: 「コンバットがいなくなったのは悔やまれる」
rows.en: “It’s a shame Combat is gone.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Combat not being around is to be mourned."

rows.jp: 「ふ……おかげでオレは楽々通学」
rows.en: “Hmph… Thanks to that, my commute is effortless.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Hu... thanks to that I can go to school all carefree."

rows.en: “You need to struggle more. Use that money you’re so good at spending to buy yourself some hardship. And once you’ve suffered, take some actual damage from it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Go get yourself more hardships. Money's your strong point, so buy some hardships with it. And then with all those hardships you can get a lot more damaged!"

rows.jp: 「難儀な注文を」
rows.en: “That is a difficult order.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Ordering difficulties."

rows.jp: 桜庭とつらつら通学する。
rows.en: Sakuraba and I ambled toward school.

ghs.en: A careful and attentive school commute with Sakuraba.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese describes traveling to school together in an unhurried sequence; 'careful and attentive' assigns an unsupported manner.

highlights.text: A careful and attentive school commute with Sakuraba.

rows.jp: と。
rows.en: And then—

ghs.en: And,

rows.jp: 「ヘックスッ！」
rows.en: “Hex-choo!”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Heh-cks!"

rows.jp: 「六角形！？」
rows.en: “A hexagon!?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hexagon?!"

rows.jp: 「ぐし……夏風邪か」
rows.en: “Snf… A summer cold?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Sniff... summer cold?"

rows.jp: くしゃみだった。
rows.en: It had been a sneeze.

ghs.en: It was a sneeze.

rows.jp: 「むぅ」
rows.en: “Mgh.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Mnuh!"

rows.jp: 桜庭の目が、あるものを注視したためにこぼれた、小さな驚きだった。
rows.en: It was a small gasp of surprise at something that had caught his eye.

ghs.en: It was a tiny exclamation of surprise caused by the subject of Sakuraba's fixed gaze.

rows.jp: 俺と桜庭との間に、橋がかかっている。
rows.en: A bridge stretched between Sakuraba and me.

ghs.en: The gap between me and Sakuraba was spanned by a bridge.

rows.jp: 片方は俺の制服の、ちょうど腹部あたり。

ghs.en: One side was on my uniform, in the precise middle of my abdomen,

ghs.en: The other side was on Sack's nose.

rows.jp: つまり。
rows.en: In other words.

ghs.en: In short,

rows.en: “Hmph…”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Hu...!"

rows.jp: 不敵に笑う。
rows.en: He grinned fearlessly.

ghs.en: He laughs invincibly.

rows.jp: 鼻汁橋できた。
rows.en: A snot bridge had formed.

ghs.en: it was a snot bridge.

rows.jp: 粘度の高い液体が、
rows.en: The viscous fluid

ghs.en: This high-viscosity fluid had, with a

rows.jp: のびろーん
rows.en: stre-e-etched

ghs.en: -streeeeiaaatch-

rows.jp: と吊り橋をかけていたのだ。
rows.en: into a suspension bridge.

ghs.en: dangled a suspension bridge between us.

rows.jp: 俺の推理はこうだ。
rows.en: Here was my deduction.

ghs.en: This is my inference.

rows.jp: くしゃみをした拍子に、打ち出された鼻汁弾は新幹線よりも速い初速で（本当）こちらの制服に打ち込まれた。
rows.en: The sneeze had launched a bullet of mucus into my uniform at an initial velocity faster than the Shinkansen’s (fact).

ghs.en: On the very downbeat of the sneeze, the launched glob of mucus fired onto to my uniform with a nuzzle velocity superior to even that of the Shinkansen (no, seriously).
ghs.assessment: The Japanese technical term is muzzle velocity; the highlighted phrase is a word-substitution error.

rows.jp: 粘着力の強い液体は、弾丸に引っ張られてむさ苦しい桜庭の鼻腔から引きずり出され、普通なら切れてしまう接続部を主人のしぶとさを彷彿とさせる粘度で保持し、橋の完成と相成った。
rows.en: Dragged along behind the projectile, the highly adhesive fluid had been pulled out of Sakuraba’s unlovely nasal cavity; where the connection would normally have snapped, a viscosity reminiscent of its owner’s tenacity held it fast, thereby completing the bridge.

ghs.en: This mightily adhesive fluid was drawn by the fired bullet and dragged from Sakuraba's nasal cavity, and this connection that normally would break had a viscosity strongly reminiscent of the stubbornness of the head of a house that made it hold, thus completing the bridge.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese refers to the weapon's owner or master, not the head of a household.

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "......"

rows.jp: その事態が、ようやくヤツにも理解できたようだ。
rows.en: At last, he seemed to understand what had happened.

ghs.en: And it seems that, at last, this guy has also understood the event.

rows.jp: スッキリした顔をしている。
rows.en: He looked refreshed.

ghs.en: His face fills with a feeling of refreshness.

rows.jp: 身動き一つ取らない。
rows.en: He did not move a muscle.

ghs.en: He does not make one movement.

rows.jp: たぶん今、コイツが考えているのは、鼻水を放出して鼻がスッキリした……というようなことだろう。賭けてもいい。
rows.en: He was probably thinking that his nose felt wonderfully clear now that he had discharged all that mucus. I would have bet on it.

ghs.en: Perhaps, right now, this guy's thinking, oh how refreshing my nose feels after a discharge of mucus... and all things of that sort. Do bet on it.

rows.jp: 「おい……はなぢる野郎」
rows.en: “Hey… snot-boy.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hey... Dung-headed Cumnose."
ghs.assessment: The English coins a compound insult whose imagery is not present in the Japanese insult.

rows.jp: 小児性に満ちた称号を授与してやった。
rows.en: I bestowed that thoroughly juvenile title upon him.

ghs.en: I bestowed him with a title full of infantile spirit.

rows.jp: 「んあー？」
rows.en: “Mmm—?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Hnha?"

rows.jp: 極度の弛緩によるものか。
rows.en: Perhaps it was the result of extreme relaxation.

ghs.en: I wouldn't know if it's because of the extreme mental strain,
ghs.assessment: The Japanese denotes relaxation or slackening; the English gives the opposite state.

rows.jp: 桜庭はぽややんとしていた。
rows.en: Sakuraba looked thoroughly spaced-out.

ghs.en: but Sakuraba looked really satisfied.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese describes a dazed or spaced-out condition, not satisfaction.

rows.jp: この！
rows.en: This brat!

ghs.en: Why you...!

rows.jp: このガキに新たなトラウマを植えつけなくてはならない。
rows.en: I had to plant a fresh trauma in him.

ghs.en: Not planting new psychological traumas in this brat is out of the question.

rows.jp: 少しでも群青っ子に近づけねばならない。
rows.en: I had to make him at least a little more like a proper Gunjo kid.

ghs.en: I must make this guy even just a little closer to a proper ultramarine of Gunjou.

rows.jp: アトランティス帝国の血が沸騰した。
rows.en: The blood of the Atlantis Empire boiled within me.

ghs.en: The blood of the Empire of Atlantis was boiling.

rows.jp: 桜庭が反応するよりはやく、冷静にハンカチを取り出す。
rows.en: Before Sakuraba could react, I calmly produced a handkerchief.

ghs.en: Faster than the Sakuraba could react, I calmly produce a handkerchief.

rows.jp: それでまず、桜庭の鼻先を包んだ。
rows.en: First, I wrapped it around the tip of his nose.

ghs.en: With it I first cover Sakuraba's nose.
Sakuraba: "...nmyu?"

rows.jp: クソ気持ちの悪い萌え声をあげる。
rows.en: He let out a revoltingly cutesy little squeak.

ghs.en: He makes a fucking creepy moe voice.

rows.jp: 根本を断ち切ってから、幾度か折り返して鼻下をぬぐう。
rows.en: I severed the bridge at its root, folded the handkerchief over several times, and wiped beneath his nose.

ghs.en: I tear apart the root then, alternating the clean spots on the hanky, wipe the subnasal so many times.

rows.jp: それから鼻汁橋を回収しつつ、自分の制服を軽く拭いた。
rows.en: Then I recovered the snot bridge and lightly wiped my uniform.

ghs.en: After that comes the collection of the snot bridge while very carefully wiping down my own uniform.

rows.jp: ハンカチをポケットに戻……さず、桜庭の顔面に押しつけた。

ghs.en: I return the hanky to pocket... not, and press it into Sakuraba's face.

rows.jp: 「おおおおおおおおおっ！？」
rows.en: “Ooooooooooh!?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "ooooOOOOOOOO?!"

rows.jp: 「んー？」
rows.en: “Hm?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hm?"

rows.en: “Is that… not a little… filthy?”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "That's... just a bit... filthy... isn't it?"

rows.jp: 「いいんだよ」
rows.en: “It’s all right.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's fine."

rows.jp: 朗らかに笑って。
rows.en: With a cheerful smile.

ghs.en: So I say with a bright smile.

rows.jp: 「おまえだから」
rows.en: “Because it’s you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's you after all."

rows.jp: ぐりぐりと押しつけた。
rows.en: I ground it against his face.

ghs.en: Grind grind I push it on him.

rows.jp: 「おうおうおうおう」
rows.en: “Ow, ow, ow, ow!”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "oUUoUUoUUoUU."

rows.jp: ぐりぐりぐりぐり
rows.en: Grind, grind, grind, grind.

ghs.en: Grind grind grind grind.

rows.jp: 「おうおうおうおう」
rows.en: “Ow, ow, ow, ow!”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "oUUoUUoUUoUU."

rows.en: It was a scene from hell.

rows.en: “This handkerchief isn’t about to let adorable little me suffer in silence.”

highlights.text: Taichi: "Leaving the most adorable Greatness That Is I crying himself to sleep is not worth a handkerchief."

rows.en: Sakuraba’s body jerked.

ghs.en: Sakuraba's body shook as if tipsy.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese gives a brief involuntary jerk or flinch; the highlighted intoxication comparison is unsupported.

rows.jp: 粘液の感触に、精神がショートしたのだろう。

rows.en: With a thud, I ground my heel into his head, then walked on.

rows.jp: 「まったく……」
rows.en: “Honestly...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Seriously."

rows.en: “That’s another memory of you and me.”

ghs.en: Sakuraba: "Once more I managed to make a memory with you."

rows.jp: 平然と隣を歩いていた。

rows.en: “Take some damage for once!!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "At least take a bit of damage!!!"

rows.jp: ハンカチ一枚で桜庭の友情を射止めてしまった。

ghs.en: A single handkerchief and I made Sakuraba's friendship all mine, dammit.
